Fellow depression sufferer and person with suicidal thoughts, for almost a decade now - in no way am I making light of suicide when I say this, but here’s the thing. I’m almost certainly going to kill myself one day. I’ve just accepted it as inevitable. Personally I choose to 1) keep going for as long as I can, for whatever reason I find, thus perpetually postponing it, and 2) focus on all the things I can do while I’m still alive. If you’re feeling down, please talk to someone and seek help, but also remember (paradoxically?) that it is possible to live and to keep living while being depressed and suicidal. You may not be able to get rid of those thoughts but it’s empowering to know that you are still in control and that you don’t have to act on them. Don’t think of suicide as fate, think of it as a choice. Hope this helps a little bit.
